definitions.gloss: fighting spirit, will to fight, combativeness
definitions.explanation: A strong determination to fight, compete, or overcome challenges. Used both for physical contests and figurative struggles.

examples.japanese: {闘志|とうし}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{燃|も}やす→燃やす：02318_moyasu⟧。
⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{闘志|とうし}あふれる⟦{選手|せんしゅ}→選手：03823_senshu⟧だ。
examples.english: He is a player brimming with fighting spirit.

examples.japanese: ⟦{負|ま}けて→負ける：01134_makeru⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧{闘志|とうし}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{失|うしな}わなかった→失う：01887_ushinau⟧。
examples.english: Even after losing, I didn't lose my fighting spirit.

examples.japanese: ⟦{相手|あいて}→相手：01677_aite⟧⟦チーム→チーム：03858_chiimu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{強|つよ}さ→強さ：25692_tsuyosa⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}て→見る：00283_miru⟧、かえって{闘志|とうし}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧わいてきた。
examples.english: Seeing the strength of the opposing team, my fighting spirit surged even more.

notes:
{闘志|とうし} refers to a fierce determination to compete or overcome adversity.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {闘志|とうし}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{燃|も}やす→燃やす：02318_moyasu⟧ (to burn with fighting spirit)
- {闘志|とうし}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧わく (fighting spirit wells up)
- {闘志|とうし}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{失|うしな}う→失う：01887_ushinau⟧ (to lose one's fighting spirit)
- {闘志|とうし}あふれる (brimming with fighting spirit)
- {闘志|とうし}むき{出|だ}し (openly combative)

USAGE:
- Common in sports and competition contexts
- Also used figuratively for determination in business or personal challenges
- Always written with {闘|とう} (fight), not {闘|たたか}
